query_analysis.original_query: We're experiencing challenges with side draw consistency in our crude distillation unit. What control strategies could improve product quality?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Identify and recommend effective control strategies to improve side draw consistency and enhance product quality in a crude distillation unit experiencing challenges with side draw consistency.

selected_agents.role: Develop control strategies to improve side draw consistency
Identify potential causes for side draw inconsistency
Provide insights on separation process impacting side draw

communication_strategy.information_flow: Collect diagnostic information from Troubleshooter and process insights from Separation Technologist to design effective control strategies
communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Iterative feedback and integrated analysis to refine control solutions

clarification_questions: Have there been any recent changes in feed composition or operating conditions?
Can you provide details on the current control system and its performance?
Which specific products or side draws are most affected by the inconsistency?
